# servcat

`servcat` provides an R interface to ServCat, the authoritative
repository for U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) data and reference
information.

Use this package to search ServCat, retrieve reference metadata, inspect
related units and subject categories, access saved collections, and
download files associated with ServCat references.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `servcat` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/USFWS) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("USFWS/servcat")
```

Then load the package:

``` r
library(servcat)
```

## Usage

### Search for references by their ID

ServCat references have unique reference IDs. If you already know the
reference ID, you can retrieve the reference record directly.

``` r
ref <- get_reference(140411)

ref
```

This is useful when you want to inspect metadata for a known ServCat
item, such as title, abstract, publication date, authors, associated
files, or related organizational information.

### Run an advanced search

Use `advanced_search()` to search ServCat with one or more search
criteria. Search criteria are sent in the body of a POST request, while
paging options control how many records are returned.

``` r
results <- advanced_search(
  criteria = list(
    quickSearch = "Kodiak goats"
  ),
  page = 1,
  page_size = 25
)

results
```

You can combine multiple criteria in the request body:

``` r
results <- advanced_search(
  criteria = list(
    quickSearch = "wetlands",
    title = "inventory",
    subjectCategories = c("Habitat", "Wetlands")
  ),
  page = 1,
  page_size = 50
)
```

The exact fields available for advanced search depend on the ServCat
API. Common criteria may include text search terms, title keywords,
author names, subject categories, reference types, organizations, dates,
and geographic filters.

### Return composite advanced search results

Some ServCat endpoints return additional composite detail for each
reference. Use composite search when you need richer results than the
standard advanced search response.

``` r
composite_results <- advanced_search(
  criteria = list(
    quickSearch = "Kodiak, goats"
  ),
  page = 1,
  page_size = 25,
  composite = TRUE
)

composite_results
```

Composite results may include additional nested information about the
reference, such as related files, organizations, people, subjects, or
other associated metadata.

### Retrieve references from a saved collection

ServCat saved collections group related references. Use
[`get_collection_references()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_collection_references.md)
with a saved collection ID to retrieve the references in that
collection.

``` r
collection_refs <- get_collection_references(1397)

collection_refs
```

This is useful when working with curated groups of references, such as
project collections, regional datasets, or topic-based ServCat
collections.

### Download files from a reference

Many ServCat references include one or more associated files. Use
[`download_reference_files()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/download_reference_files.md)
to download files attached to a reference.

``` r
download_reference_files(
  reference_id = 140411,
  path = "data-raw/servcat-files"
)
```

You can also use this function in a loop or with
[`lapply()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/lapply.html)/[`purrr::map()`](https://purrr.tidyverse.org/reference/map.html)
to download files from multiple references.

``` r
reference_ids <- c(140411, 140412, 140413)

lapply(
  reference_ids,
  download_reference_files,
  path = "data-raw/servcat-files"
)
```

### Get units associated with a reference

ServCat references can be associated with one or more FWS units. Use
`get_reference_units()` to retrieve those units.

``` r
units <- get_reference_units(140411)

units
```

### Get geographic bounding boxes

Use `get_reference_bounding_boxes()` to retrieve geographic bounding box
coordinates associated with a reference.

``` r
bbox <- get_reference_bounding_boxes(140411)

bbox
```

Bounding boxes can help identify the geographic extent of a reference
and may be useful for mapping or spatial filtering workflows.

### Get subject categories

Use `get_reference_subjects()` to retrieve the subject categories
associated with a ServCat reference.

``` r
subjects <- get_reference_subjects(140411)

subjects
```

Subject categories can help classify references by topic and support
more targeted searches.

### Get reference types

Use
[`get_reference_types()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_reference_types.md)
to retrieve the list of ServCat reference types.

``` r
reference_types <- get_reference_types()

reference_types
```

Reference types can be useful when building advanced searches or
filtering results to particular kinds of records.

## Example workflow

A typical workflow might look like this:

``` r
library(servcat)

# Search ServCat
results <- advanced_search(
  criteria = list(
    quickSearch = "Kodiak goats"
  ),
  page = 1,
  page_size = 10,
  composite = TRUE
)

# Inspect one reference ID from the results
ref <- get_reference(140411)

# Retrieve related metadata
units <- get_reference_units(140411)
subjects <- get_reference_subjects(140411)
bbox <- get_reference_bounding_boxes(140411)

# Download associated files
download_reference_files(
  reference_id = 140411,
  path = "data-raw/servcat-files"
)
```

## Notes

`servcat` wraps the ServCat REST API and returns R objects suitable for
downstream analysis, reporting, and data management workflows.

Because ServCat records can vary in structure, some returned fields may
be missing, empty, or nested depending on the reference, endpoint, and
search type used.

## Getting help

Contact a [project maintainer](mailto:mccrea_cobb@fws.gov) for help with
this repository.

If you have general questions on creating repositories in the USFWS
DGEC, reach out to a USFWS DGEC
[owner](https://github.com/orgs/USFWS/people?query=role%3Aowner).

## Contribute

Contact the project maintainer for information about contributing to
this repository.

Submit a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/USFWS/servcat/issues) to
report a bug or request a feature or enhancement.

When reporting an issue, please include:

- A brief description of the problem.
- A minimal reproducible example, if possible.
- The function you were using.
- The ServCat reference ID, collection ID, or search criteria involved.
- Your R version and `servcat` package version.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`download_reference_files()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/download_reference_files.md)
  : Download files from a ServCat reference
- [`get_bibliography()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_bibliography.md)
  : Get bibliography metadata for a ServCat reference from the secure
  ServCat API
- [`get_bounding_boxes()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_bounding_boxes.md)
  : Get geographic bounding boxes from a ServCat reference
- [`get_collection_references()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_collection_references.md)
  : Get references in a saved collection
- [`get_external_links()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_external_links.md)
  : Get external links from a ServCat reference
- [`get_file_info()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_file_info.md)
  : Get digital file metadata from a ServCat reference
- [`get_keywords()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_keywords.md)
  : Get keywords from a ServCat reference
- [`get_lifecycle_info()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_lifecycle_info.md)
  : Get lifecycle information from the secure ServCat API
- [`get_reference_owners()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_reference_owners.md)
  : Get reference owners from the secure ServCat API
- [`get_subjects()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_subjects.md)
  : Get subject categories from a ServCat reference
- [`get_taxa()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_taxa.md)
  : Get taxa associated with a ServCat reference
- [`get_units()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/get_units.md)
  : Get units associated with a ServCat reference
- [`search_references_advanced()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/search_references_advanced.md)
  : Execute an Advanced Search
- [`search_references_by_id()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/search_references_by_id.md)
  : Search ServCat references by ID
- [`search_references_by_id_basic()`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/search_references_by_id_basic.md)
  : Search ServCat references by ID and return basic fields
- [`servcat`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/servcat-package.md)
  [`servcat-package`](https://ideal-adventure-2qyoqkw.pages.github.io/reference/servcat-package.md)
  : servcat: Access the ServCat REST API
